importWizard.detected: These files look like an export of {source}.
importWizard.done.dates: Creation and edit dates are kept as the properties created and updated.
importWizard.done.title: Imported into “{folder}”
importWizard.error.failed: The import stopped ({error}). Nothing was left half-written; your vault is as it was.
importWizard.error.nothing: No notes in these files. Check that they are the export of {source}.
importWizard.how.appleNotes: Apple Notes has no export of its own: save the notes as HTML or Markdown with an exporter app, then pick the folder or a .zip of it. Images inside the notes come along.
importWizard.how.bear: In Bear: File → Backup notes (.bearbk), or Export notes as TextBundle. Pick the file or the folder.
importWizard.how.evernote: In Evernote: select a notebook or notes → Export → ENEX (.enex). Pick one or more .enex files; each notebook becomes a folder.
importWizard.how.keep: At takeout.google.com choose only Keep and download the .zip. Pick it as it came; labels become tags, archived notes go to Archive/.
importWizard.how.logseq: Pick the graph folder (the one with pages/ and journals/), or a .zip of it. Properties, block references and tasks are converted.
importWizard.how.lumen: A Lumen export (.zip), or any folder of Markdown files.
importWizard.how.notion: In Notion: Settings → Export → Markdown & CSV (or HTML), with subpages. Pick the .zip as it came. Every database becomes a .base file with the same columns.
importWizard.how.obsidian: Pick the vault folder, or a .zip of it. Obsidian's own settings (.obsidian) are left out.
importWizard.how.onenote: In OneNote for Windows: File → Export → Page or Section → Single File Web Page (.mht). Pick one or more .mht files.
importWizard.intro: Bring your notes from another app. Everything goes into a new folder: nothing you already have is changed, and one click takes the import back.
importWizard.lost: {n} attachments of the export are not in the vault.
importWizard.reason.duplicate: another copy of a file that is imported
importWizard.reason.unreadable: the file is damaged, or not what this source exports
importWizard.reason.unsupported: a format this source cannot convert
importWizard.report.heading: Import report
importWizard.report.save: Save the report as a note
importWizard.review.links: Internal links: {resolved} of {total} reach their note or file ({pct}%).
importWizard.review.summary: {notes} notes, {attachments} attachments and {bases} databases will go into “{folder}”.
importWizard.title: Import notes
importWizard.undoGone: Nothing to undo: the import's folder is no longer there.
importWizard.undone: The import is undone: the vault is as it was before.
importWizard.undoneTrash: The import is undone. You had changed files in it, so the folder is in the trash.
importWizard.warn.encryptedPart: an encrypted part was left out
importWizard.warn.missingAttachment: an attachment it points at is not in the export
importWizard.warn.noDates: the export has no creation or edit dates
importWizard.warn.notionComputed: a Notion formula or rollup column: its values came across, the formula did not (add it as a formula column in the base)
importWizard.warn.notionUnparsed: a Notion value that does not fit its column's type was kept as text
